messages.subject: Re: can't install on linux
messages.body_plain:
Hello:

Did you install the GTK development files? I mean headers (*.h) and
those?

On Apr 19, 2:05 pm, "bdmccullo...@drexel.edu"

<bdmccullo...@drexel.edu> wrote:
> Running Fedora Core 5, with R 2.4.1
>
>         I have libglade2 installed.  From R issue the command to
> install GTK+
>         and get an error message
>
>         checking for pkg-config... /usr/bin/pkg-config
>         checking pkg-config is at least version 0.9.0... yes
>         checking for GTK... configure: error: GTK version 2.8.0
> required
>         ERROR: configuration failed for package 'RGtk2'
>         ** Removing '/usr/lib/R/library/RGtk2'
>
>         I cannot find GTK version 2.8.0 for FC5; rpmfind.net <http://rpmfind.net> gives
> only
>         libglade2-2.5.1-4.fc5.1.i386
>         as the most recent version, which I already have installed.
>
>         Help!
>
>         Regards,
>
>         Bruce
